newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won edges up in line with yen's rise.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won edges up in line with yen's rise.

text.p: The won edged up against the dollar by Wednesday's midday in line with the Japanese yen's strength versus the dollar in global markets, dealers said.
But the won's rise was limited by fears of the central bank's dollar buying intervention, they said.
"The Bank of Korea appears to think the dollar should stay above the 890 line," said a foreign bank dealer.

The won rose to 890.60 near the morning close, against Tuesday's closing of 891.10. It opened at a low of 890.90 and touched a high of 890.50. Dealers forecast a trading range between 890.00 and 891.00 for the afternoon.
